title: lithocarpus harmandii
intro: Lithocarpus harmandii, commonly known as the Himalayan Lithocarpus, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family Fagaceae. The Himalayan Lithocarpus has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus harmandii include its potential to treat conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer, due in part to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus harmandii may also contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
